title: Single-vertex flat folding
notes: Keep one adult at each table; that adult can fold a child-chosen labeling when dexterity is the obstacle. On return, K-1 can use fixed-ray/tab-stock questions (P3-4) or routes through the eight folds (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can add a ray, collect labelings, or arrange the six wedges (P4-6). Grades 4-5 can separate the full right-angle classification (P4-5) from the angle-order count (P6). Reuse labeled models and keep the three wedge sets separate. The actual-paper pretest on guide pp2-3 remains required and unperformed.
